facts.text: W Ibiza is on the palm-fringed beachfront of Santa Eulalia.
facts.excerpt: W Ibiza luxury beach hotel strikes a pose on the palm-fringed, sand-drenched beachfront of Santa Eulalia.

facts.text: The hotel is on Ibiza's east coast.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located on the east coast
Open seasonally from April 29 to October 17, 2027

facts.text: WET Deck has a pool, a bar with light bites and sun loungers, with direct access to the beach.
facts.excerpt: WET Deck combines a design-forward pool, destination bar serving light bites and comfy sun loungers, with direct access to Santa Eulalia’s sandy, palm-fringed beach.

facts.text: GLOW is a rooftop with an infinity pool looking out across Santa Eulalia Bay.
facts.excerpt: GLOW with rooftop infinity pool and premium sun loungers looks out across Eulalia Bay

facts.text: GLOW is an adults-only rooftop with 360-degree views, night swims and DJ sets.
facts.excerpt: With 360° rooftop views over Santa Eulalia and beyond, our adults-only haven is the perfect spot to get some perspective. With everything from night swims, masterful mixology, delicious shisha, and dynamic DJ sets on the menu

facts.text: Rooms mix splatter paints and colorful fabrics inspired by hippie summers.
facts.excerpt: Mixing up kaleidoscopic splatter paints and colorful fabrics with the vibrancy of hippie summers

facts.text: Most rooms have a walk-on balcony.
facts.excerpt: 90% of all our luxury hotel rooms in Ibiza have a walk-on balcony
W Ibiza has direct access to the beach as well as Ibiza hotel rooms with private pools

facts.text: The duplex Penthouse Suite is on the top floor with a very large balcony and sea views.
facts.excerpt: our one-and-only Penthouse Suite sits on the most elevated floor and totally steals the scene. No surprise, we've thought of everything. Take in the sun, cocktail in hand, from the super-large balcony with far out sea views. This is duplex living

facts.text: Rooms have a Mixbar in-room cocktail service with designer martini glasses.
facts.excerpt: Consider Mixbar your personal cocktail service, complete with designer martini glasses.

facts.text: AWAY Spa offers more than 15 treatments, including skincare, manicures and pedicures.
facts.excerpt: Immerse in a revitalizing spa Ibiza experience with more than 15 treatments to relax from skincare, manicure and pedicure.

facts.text: The FIT gym is open 24/7 with Technogym equipment and graffiti-covered walls.
facts.excerpt: Open 24/7, this is where state-of-the-art Technogym equipment, free weights and a medley of private classes with specialized trainers, meet graffiti-emblazoned walls

facts.text: Yellow Fish Restaurant serves grilled local fish, Spanish tapas and sangria overlooking Santa Eulalia's shore.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the shores of Santa Eulalia, Yellow Fish Restaurant captures the Mediterranean spirit with bohemian elegance. Grilled local fish, Spanish tapas and refreshing sangrias

facts.text: Santa Eulalia has a beachfront promenade that is good for bar-hopping at night.
facts.excerpt: Stroll along its famous beachfront promenade that at night becomes perfect for bar-hopping.

facts.text: Ibiza Airport is about 22 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near W Ibiza is Ibiza Airport (IBZ). IBZ is located approximately 21.6 KM from the hotel.
